threat_event: A fraudulent money-movement request from a hijacked or spoofed email is processed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trusted internal senders; advisers act on email requests
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (call-backs; second review over $50,000); EV-082 (advisers receive transfer requests by email, including from internal senders)
existing_controls: Call-back to the number of record; custodian call-backs; second review over $50,000
treatment_plan: Treat internal-sender requests the same as external; red flags for tax-document references

threat_event: An adviser mailbox is taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Number-matching MFA; inbox-rule alerts in place for Wealth
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (number-matching MFA); EV-010 (inbox-rule alerts cover Wealth mailboxes)

threat_event: Integrated planning data held by Tax and Advisory is breached and Wealth learns late
threat_source: Attacker at the service provider affiliate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrated planning agreement lacks the 72-hour notice term
likelihood_basis: EV-004 (integrated planning agreement without the 72-hour term)
treatment_plan: Amend the agreement; add Tax and Advisory to service provider oversight

threat_event: Regulation S-P customer notices are late in a cross-division incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clock starts when Wealth becomes aware; combined matrix not exercised
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (30-day clock from awareness); EV-024 (no combined matrix or cross-division exercise)

threat_event: Wealth analytics uses tax-derived data that no consent covers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Statistical compilations built from referral fields

threat_event: AI meeting summaries are not preserved as required records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot tool outside the communications archive
likelihood_basis: EV-062 (AI-005 pilot not an archive source); EV-033 (400-adviser pilot)
existing_controls: Advisers keep their own notes in the CRM

threat_event: Sensitive client data is entered into a non-approved AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Approved tools list exists; blocking incomplete
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (approved-tools list); EV-082 (blocking of other AI tools incomplete)
treatment_plan: Block public AI tools on Wealth devices

threat_event: The integration hub or a custodian feed is compromised
treatment_plan: Feed integrity alerts in the SIEM

threat_event: A client portal account is taken over to change address or bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal MFA required; step-up for money movement
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (portal MFA; step-up for money movement)
existing_controls: MFA; change notices to the old address

threat_event: A departing adviser takes client lists
The trading platform is unavailable during market hours
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (one portfolio management vendor); EV-064 (custodian trading desks)
treatment_plan: Annual failover test with the vendor

threat_event: Identity theft red flags on account changes are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Red flags program written for external requests only
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (red flags written for external requests and account changes)
treatment_plan: Add red flags for requests citing tax documents or internal senders

threat_event: A gap in the communications archive loses required records
treatment_plan: Accepted: reconciliation detects gaps within a day; vendor replays

threat_event: A planning software vendor is breached
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (planning software vendor contract with 72-hour notice)

threat_event: Consumer report information is not disposed of properly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disposal procedure covers paper and devices

threat_event: An SEC examination finds weak service provider oversight
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Affiliate service providers not in the oversight program
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (affiliates not in the oversight program)
treatment_plan: Add affiliates to the oversight program
